Downloads.Description:
下载前置之后，直接放入Mods文件夹即可。如果你习惯将图片放入999里，也建议打PortraiturePlus以确保每个季节和节日的肖像正常使用。
Make sure you have Portraiture and PortraiturePlus installed, then simply put this mod into the Mods folder.
